SELECT MAX(f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") AS MaxEligibleFreeRate
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)" > 0.3;

SELECT MAX(frm."Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") AS MaxEligibleFreeRate
FROM frpm frm
JOIN satscores sat ON frm.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE (frm."Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)" * frm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") / frm."NumTstTakr" > 0.3;

SELECT MAX(f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`) AS HighestEligibleFreeRate
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` > 0.3;

SELECT MAX(T1.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`) AS MaxEligibleFreeRate
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T2.NumGE1500 / T2.enroll12 > 0.3;

SELECT MAX(T1.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`) AS MaxEligibleFreeRate
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = SUBSTR(T2.cds, 2)
WHERE T2.AvgScrRead > 500 AND T2.AvgScrMath > 500 AND T2.AvgScrWrite > 500;

SELECT MAX(T2.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`) AS MaxEligibleFreeRate
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.sname = T2.School Name AND T1.dname = T2.District Name
WHERE T1.NumGE1500 / T1.enroll12 > 0.3;

SELECT MAX(frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`) AS HighestEligibleFreeRate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` > 0.3;

SELECT MAX(frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`) AS HighestEligibleFreeRate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` > 0.3;

SELECT MAX(frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`) AS MaxEligibleFreeRate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE (frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` * frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 0.3;

SELECT MAX(frpm."Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") AS MaxEligibleFreeRate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE 
    (frpm."Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)" * frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") / frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 0.3;

SELECT MAX(frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`) AS MaxEligibleFreeRate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE 
    (frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` * frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 0.3 * frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
ORDER BY MaxEligibleFreeRate DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`) AS MaxEligibleFreeRate
